title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(吉田啓史郎研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Yoshida Keishiro)
keywords: Aeronautics 2.Aircraft structure 3.Structural mechanics 4.Composite materials 5.Cooperation with community
educationalGoal: Based on the fundamental knowledge of aeronautical engineering and the fundamental skills for designing and manufacturing aircrafts and their components, students will develop their ability to design actual aircrafts and their components and their ability to apply aeronautical engineering theory to solve real aircraft technical problems. Students will also learn the importance of cooperation with society (community in particular) to advance their ideas.
advice: The department of aeronautics aims to develop engineers who can support the development of transportation machines such as aircraft by using their knowledge of aeronautics and their skills on mechanical design and manufacturing. Design Project III is a culmination subject in the final stage of the curriculum. The targets of this subject are the following: -to develop the ability to design actual aircrafts and their components -to develop the ability to apply aeronautical engineering theory to solve real aircraft technical problems -to develop the ability to evaluate the phenomena that occur in real aircraft based on aeronautics In this laboratory, students conduct research on technical issues on composite materials used for aircraft structures. A detailed project theme is decided through discussion with the teacher. Students will discover their own problems and solve them. Students must also understand the targets of this subject and the content of this course based on the syllabus.
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Because Design Project III is based on lectures, experiments, and practice of quarters 1-6 in the department of aeronautics, students must review them appropriately as needed.

activityGoals.body: Be able to establish a project theme and put it into action based on an engineering design process
Be able to summarize activities as documents and conduct the presentation with related discussion
Be able to perform design, drafting, manufacturing (production) and simulation

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Students clearly understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose. (2)Students prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it with related discussion. Students prepare their research results as a final report and present it with related discussion in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. (3)For problems on aircraft structure design, students can realize a solution by making full use of design tools such as 3D-CAD and structural analysis software.
achievementLevels.standard: (1)Students clearly understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose. (2)Students should prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it. Students prepare their research results as a final report and present it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. (3)For problems on aircraft structure design, students can examine a solution by using design tools such as 3D-CAD and structural analysis software with instruction.

lessons.content: Course orientation Students learn engineering design process that includes establishing a project theme, summarizing their activities in document, and making oral presentation on their activities. Students self-check on their activities based on the discussion at laboratory weekly meeting and at interim and final presentation meetings held by department of aeronautics.
lessons.operation: Seminars, Study sessions, Oral presentations, Self-checks
lessons.assignments: Literature survey such as academic papers and technical reports. Acquire knowledge on mechanics of materials and structural mechanics. Acquire skills to properly use finite element analysis software.
